details: @c1-ease/autoloan is a dependency-confusion package: its description is "Compatibility shim." and its README calls it an "authorized dependency-confusion test" by "Kero (@0xWise)". Each listed version has a postinstall script that runs `node beacon.cjs` on npm install, and index.js runs the same code when the package is imported; it POSTs the hostname, install path and current working directory to `https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc` with TLS certificate checks turned off, and index.js exports a Proxy of no-op functions so builds that import the real package keep running. The npm account ppblpp1 published @c1-ease/autoloan and 7 other packages with the same beacon on 2026-11-21 between 21:34 and 22:09 UTC.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
